primary.name: PR_AUC
primary.definition: average precision: AP = sum_k (R_k - R_{k-1}) * P_k over distinct score thresholds in descending order, tied scores forming one threshold; with case weights w_i (bootstrap multiplicities) every count is weighted
primary.primary_quantity: Delta PR-AUC = PR-AUC(M2) - PR-AUC(M0), primary class at lambda = 10, on the pooled out-of-fold development predictions (8 folds) and, separately, on the LOCKED_CONTEXT_UNSEEN_VALIDATION block
primary.relative: Delta / PR-AUC(M0), reported but never used alone
primary.pooling: pooled across asset-eras and weeks of the evaluation set (as specified by the sponsor)

secondary.ROC_AUC: Mann-Whitney U with average ranks for ties
secondary.TOP_DECILE_LIFT_XSEC: within each evaluation week rank the risk-set assets; top decile = ceil(10%) highest; lift = (sum of positives in weekly top deciles / their count) / (overall positive rate); never formed by pooling weeks (inherited H18.3 section 8a)
secondary.CALIBRATION: slope and intercept of a logistic regression of y on logit(p) (unpenalised); reliability table in 10 equal-count bins; expected calibration error reported
secondary.WITHIN_WEEK_PR_AUC: mean over weeks with >= 1 positive of the within-week PR-AUC (separates cross-sectional ranking from calendar-regime prediction, because context is common to all assets in a week)
secondary.PER_FOLD: every metric per fold with unique events, landmark weeks and asset-eras
secondary.PER_ERA: Delta PR-AUC for 2022 folds (1-4), 2023 folds (5-8) and the 2025 LOCKED_CONTEXT_UNSEEN_VALIDATION block

reported_counts: always with landmark rows, unique asset-eras, unique positive events and distinct weeks; positive landmark weeks are never called events
no_outcome_tuning: no threshold is chosen; every metric is threshold-free except the top-decile rule fixed here
amendment: A02.1 / A02.2 (fixed lambda; terminology); metric definitions unchanged
